prompt: {{component}}'s {{runnable}} should not wait for {{operation}} on {{port}}; start a new runnable {{callback}} when it returns.
note: The first synchronous call in row order whose port and operation no other call of its component names, so no mixed-synchrony finding can follow; the callback is a new runnable whose one event is the call_returned of that pair, named On<Operation>Returned with the first free numeric suffix. The call keeps its other fields.
